name: dp-sk-metodika-convert
description: Converts grabbed Slovak guidance PDFs into <itemId>.plan.json load plans: metadata of the grab wins, text from the PDF text layer or local OCR (slk). Writes files only.
author: open-lex-it

execute.description: For each item read the grab output from dirIn and write <itemId>.plan.json into dirOut. A document that cannot be read is recorded as skipped with a reason; the item still ends ok.

items.description: the items to convert, as reported by the detect step

dirIn.description: directory with the grab output (one sub-directory per item)

maxDocs.description: convert only the first N documents of an item, ascending by source_id

only.description: convert only these documents: objects with section or site and docId (the source_id)

dryRun.description: read and count, write no plan file

output.description: { dirOut, converted: [{key, plan, meta}], metrics: {documents, ocr, skipped, warnings} }
